clouds:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent mobile-game cloud sprite sheet, two rows, canvas 1536 x 1024 landscape. Image 1 is the STYLE reference: soft sculpted cream-white cloud with pale blue-gray underside. Create two MUCH WIDER and LOWER cloud formations in exactly that polished friendly miniature 3D game style, upper-left warm daylight, quiet matte material, smooth clean silhouettes.
Top row: ONE continuous horizontal cloud bank, width about 1300px, height about 330px, centered at x768 y280, with a broad low bed and a few small rounded billows. Overall visible silhouette about 4:1, distinctly horizontal, not a tall heap.
Bottom row: ONE continuous thin stretched cloud ribbon, width about 1400px, height about 125px, centered at x768 y770. Overall silhouette about 11:1, shallow billows and a delicate tapered profile. It should feel like a distant thin cloud layer rather than a contrail drawn with a ruler.
Keep the TWO clouds fully separate with ample transparent space between the two rows. Both entire silhouettes must be visible without touching canvas edges. There must be no other object, no ground or sky color, no duplicate miniature clouds, no borders, no text, no labels, no grid, no glow or dark outline. Real transparent background. Preserve subtle pale warm highlights and muted cool underside shading. Avoid photographic detail and heavy contrast. Final runtime sprites will be uniformly downsampled, so clear simple shapes are important.
